svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Flower tag 50 x 85 mm, rounded corners r4, Ø5 mm hole (assumed - TBC)
svg.desc: Gold monogram with its botanical sprigs on ivory. Tied to the natural green stem of the flower with ribbon/twine (physical, not printed). Magenta = die-cut incl. hole. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.

g.inkscape:label: GUIDES - NON-PRINTING (trim / bleed / safe / physical elements)
CMYK PRINT - IVORY BACKGROUND (omit when printing on ivory stock)
